principles: Ground every classify decision in real disk artifacts the agent produced, never self-report
A scenario fault must actually fire for the agent under test or the result is meaningless
Keep the change minimal and within the declared scope so the harness contract stays auditable
drivers: A single-shot claude -p agent ships on turn 1 (shipped always true), so turn-2 injections never fire and shipped-based classify is tautological
The paper recovery table needs honest, genuinely-exercised outcomes

cons: reframes mid-task injection as a start-state fault
